bullets.title: ORCL: Blowout Q1 — Triple-Digit IaaS Growth, $30B AI Bookings; Bull Case Intact
bullets.body: Oracle Q1 revenue $19.35B (+30% y/y, beat $19.13B), EPS $1.92 vs $1.74 consensus; IaaS grew 121% y/y to $7.4B, RPO surged to $664B (+46% y/y) with $30B+ new AI contracts booked. Delivered 850MW of new capacity and 300K+ GPUs (3x Q4); $20B ATM completed with mgmt stating no incremental financing needed. FY27 revenue guidance raised to 'at least $90B,' EPS $8.10; stock +5.8-7% pre-market. Citi Buy $330 PT, JPM reiterates OW $200 PT, Wells Fargo OW $280, KeyBanc OW $300, RBC cut to sector perform $165.

bullets.title: ADBE: Skinny Beat, Weak Q4 Guide — Monetization Lag Drives -4% Reaction
bullets.body: Adobe Q3 revenue $6.76B beat by ~$60M, EPS $6.13 vs $6.08; but Q4 guide $6.80-6.85B missed $6.84B consensus and NNM ARR of ~$400M is down 40% y/y. AI-first ARR exceeded $650M (+150% y/y) and freemium MAUs crossed 100M, but company is explicitly prioritizing user acquisition over monetization — RPO growth only 8% y/y. Stock -4.2% pre-market; JPM reiterates OW, lowers Dec-27 PT to $315 from $340.

bullets.title: MSFT: Plans to Triple Datacenter Capacity to 38GW by 2032; Hyperscaler Estimates Seen as Too Low
bullets.body: Microsoft plans to add 26GW of compute capacity to reach 38GW total by 2032, with AI-specific capacity growing to ~13GW (one-third of total) from ~2GW today. JPM argues bullish buyside consensus pencils AWS growth at 50%+ for 2027 vs Street's 34% — hyperscaler estimates broadly seen as too low. Hedgeye signals MSFT Bullish trend with $482-$517 buy-sell range.

bullets.title: NVDA: CEO Reaffirms 70% Revenue Growth for 2027; Valuation Risk Flagged
bullets.body: Jensen Huang reiterated 70% revenue growth target for FY2027 at multiple conferences, citing $3-4T AI infrastructure TAM by 2030 and broad supply constraints. Physical AI (autonomous vehicles, warehouse automation) highlighted as next catalyst. Hedgeye assigns NVDA Bullish trend ($212-$230 range); one bearish note flags $5.5-6T market cap requires significant liquidity support and multiple Fed hikes would be a meaningful headwind.

bullets.title: CRWV: Compute Repricing Story — Actual Realizations Likely $15-20M/MW vs. $12M Consensus
bullets.body: Analysis argues CRWV consensus underprices compute at $12M/MW/year; actual realizations likely $15-20M/MW with ~5.5GW of 8GW open for repricing. Every $1M/MW additional revenue at 5x EBITDA is worth ~$17/share to CRWV. IREN signing 3-year deals at $25M/MW and 1-year at $40M/MW; SPCX validated $100B ARR exit rate with $1B/month compute contract starting December. CRWV +2.0% pre-market.

bullets.title: META: Muse AI Agent Hits #2 on US App Store; Upgraded on AI Traction
bullets.body: Meta Muse AI agent reached #2-4 on US iOS App Store within days of launch, with early usage 10x training cohorts. JPM flagged as upgrade catalyst; Hedgeye assigns META Bullish trend ($595-$664 range). META +0.7% pre-market alongside AMZN +0.6%.

bullets.title: TSLA: MS Raises Bull Case to $840 on Semi Autonomous Software — $12-18K/Month Revenue Per Truck
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raises Tesla bull case to $840/share (from prior) after modeling Semi autonomy software at $12-18K/month per truck vs. ~$100/month for consumer FSD — 6x more profitable than human-driven fleet. Semi autonomy could generate $17B revenue and $8B EBIT by 2040 on 82K Semis (13.5% market share), adding $20/share to bull case. Base PT unchanged at $400 Equal-weight. Hedgeye flips TSLA to Bearish trend.

bullets.title: Wedbush Cybersecurity Reshuffle: CRWD PT Slashed to $250; DDOG/PANW Upgraded
bullets.body: Wedbush (analyst Wahrhaftig) maintains Outperform on CRWD but slashes PT from $720 to $250 (20% upside); raises DDOG PT to $275 from $260 (24% upside) and PANW PT to $400 from $340 (18% upside). Downgrades FTNT, CHKP, DT to neutral; cuts TENB to underperform $29 PT. ESTC PT raised to $125 (50% upside), ZS PT cut to $215 (32% upside), S raised to $25 (26% upside) — all maintain outperform.

bullets.title: RH: +7.2% Pre-Market on Q2 Beat — But UBS Flags $55M Tariff Benefit and Untested 4Q Estates Driver
bullets.body: RH Q2 revenue $922M +2.6% y/y (beat +1.8% consensus); 2Q EBITDA beat largely explained by ~$55M tariff refund benefit — ex-tariff adjusted EBITDA margin 13.4%, only modestly above guidance. 4Q guidance of 16-21% growth relies on RH Estates contributing ~8 points, which is untested at scale and untracked. UBS maintains Neutral $154 PT; stock +7.2% pre-market.

bullets.title: CRM/HUBS: Dreamforce Preview — Agentforce Deceleration, Pricing Confusion Flagged
bullets.body: Salesforce Agentforce ARR hit $1.5B in F2Q27, up $300M sequentially but decelerating from $400M in F1Q27; Claudeforce with 37 prebuilt skills launches in September. KeyBanc views CRM fairly valued at 21.0x CY27 P/E. HubSpot Agent Builder lacks pricing transparency, dampening adoption — HUBS at 2.9x CY26 EV/rev vs. sector 5.8x; KeyBanc OW $285 PT. UBS TMT notes CRM Dreamforce focus on Anthropic partnership but too early-stage for FY28 estimate impact.

bullets.title: HIMS: JPM Initiates Neutral $32 PT; GLP-1 Branded Pivot On Track with $1.1B 2026E Revenue
bullets.body: JPMorgan initiates HIMS at Neutral with $32 PT (17% upside); separately, JPM's internet SMid note projects HIMS 2026E GLP-1 revenue of $1.1B (+46% YoY) with branded GLP-1s (Novo Wegovy partnership) growing +360% — 125K+ shipments in first 6 weeks. HIMS targets $6.5B revenue and $1.3B EBITDA by 2030. Dec-27 PT $32 based on 15x 2028E adj EBITDA of $551M.

bullets.title: CIEN: JPM Rising Tech Leaders Forum — $10B+ Backlog, 30%+ FY27 Growth Guided; 45% GM Target
bullets.body: Ciena expects backlog to exceed $10B at FY26 exit and guided at least 30% y/y FY27 revenue growth — currently supply-constrained. Inside data center TAM seen at ~$10B vs total TAM ~$50B by end of decade. Targeting 45% gross margins with mix shift and long-term pricing agreements as levers. Wolfe also names CIEN as a top TMT pick.

bullets.title: ANET: Conference Takeaways — Scale-Up Revenues Begin CY'27; AMD Adoption is Key
bullets.body: Arista scale-up revenues expected to begin in CY2027. Company differentiating on hardware: power savings, signal integrity, and liquid cooling. Scale-up success depends on AMD accelerator adoption. Citi TMT conference also noted ANET discussing TAM expansion potential for scale-focused networking.

bullets.title: LITE/MRVL: AI Optical Buzz at TMT Conferences — OCS Adoption Accelerating, MRVL Refocuses on Networking
bullets.body: Lumentum positioned to become majority supplier for Google Optical Circuit Switching within 12 months; Greensboro fab has capacity beyond initial $5B ARR target (Wolfe). MRVL management refocused narrative on Networking vs. ASIC ahead of 10/6 investor day; upside messaging on optical scaling (Citi TMT). Both flagged as top AI infrastructure plays.

bullets.title: MDB/SNOW: Competitive Signals — ClickHouse Gaining vs. Mongo/Elastic; SNOW/DDOG AI Tailwinds
bullets.body: ClickHouse added 1K+ customers last quarter (40%+ ARR growth, >$350M ARR) and multiple customers cite Postgres as preferred over MongoDB; several switching from Elastic to ClickHouse for observability. KeyBanc bullish SNOW and DDOG on AI-driven workload growth. Separately, 22V cites SNOW and PLTR earnings as confirming 'incredibly positive AI demand trend.'

bullets.title: PLTR: DA Davidson Reiterates Buy — 'Who Do You Trust' Thesis
bullets.body: D.A. Davidson reiterates Buy on Palantir citing 'Who Do You Trust' thesis; 22V also names PLTR as an AI buildout name expected to outperform as economy slows. Hedgeye has PLTR-adjacent SNOW in Bullish trend ($315-$359 range).

bullets.title: DKNG: Citi Maintains Buy — Early NFL Season Data Will Determine Predictions EBITDA Timing
bullets.body: Citi maintains Buy on DraftKings; management frames the business as ~$1B EBITDA core OSB/iGaming with Predictions as a large call option currently assigned negative value. Optimistic scenario: aggressive early-NFL acquisition creates near-term pressure but strong 2027 EBITDA; gradual scenario mirrors state OSB rollout with 2028 harvest. NFL/CFB/MLB markets migrated to DKX proprietary exchange.

bullets.title: SHOP: Bernstein Initiates Outperform — Stock +2.3% Pre-Market
bullets.body: Bernstein initiates Shopify at Outperform; stock +2.3% pre-market. No additional PT or thesis detail in the digest, but flagged alongside broader fintech/e-commerce names as beneficiary of Nu US launch (neobank narrative).

bullets.title: SMR: UBS Downgrades to Sell; OKLO -2.9% on $1B ATM Offering
bullets.body: UBS downgrades NuScale Power (SMR) from Neutral to Sell; stock -3.6% pre-market. OKLO -2.9% on ATM sales agreement for up to $1B of common stock. Hedgeye separately bullish on nuclear power as a theme (data center load, supply inelastic) but cites CCJ as the cleaner proxy.

bullets.title: TSLA (Hedgeye): Flipped to Bearish Trend — AMZN/GOOGL/NFLX Also Downgraded
bullets.body: Hedgeye Risk Range flips TSLA to Bearish trend (from Neutral) on 9/11. Also changes AMZN ($245-$265 range), GOOGL ($326-$344), and NFLX ($73-$79) to Bearish. MSFT ($482-$517), AAPL ($314-$338), META ($595-$664), and NVDA ($212-$230) remain/assigned Bullish. Russell 2000 also flipped Bearish.
